name: The Miller's Daughter
source:
His father, the old miller, had married for the third time after the death of his two previous wives and had inherited from the previous marriage this daughter whom no one wanted to take care of. He thinks that this girl is not particulary useful, nor does she have the looks to fetch a husband and leave.  She is skinny, sickly, and, as she is the least protected, therefore the last to eat, she is weak from hunger ans malnutrition. She has only one talent, which is spinning linen. And that's why a windmill full of straw has become her prison.
Her name is [spoiler]Hoppe[/spoiler].
